MB-SEQ-0.1 candidate for Member B (Chengsi Li, @ChengsiLi).
Traceability: AH-01 -> UC-01 / UC-01E -> Sequence Diagram (Criterion C9).
1. Customer Portal communicates solely through authenticated REST endpoints.
2. Idempotency guarantees safe retries without duplicate Case generation.
3. Statements and evidence are append-only; clarification never overwrites prior customer input.
4. Clarification is modelled as an iterative loop with multi-round branching, timeout and escalation.
